create.name: Scott M. Taylor
create.bio:
Scott M. Taylor is an American researcher and meditation guide who works with near-death and shared-death experiences. His interest began in 1981, after a car accident killed the woman he loved and, days later, her young son; at the boy's death Taylor had what he describes as a shared-death experience. He went on to write a doctoral dissertation on near-death experiences, has trained people for The Monroe Institute since 1985 and later served as its president and executive director, and has served two terms as a director of IANDS, the near-death studies association. Before this became his main work he was a company chief executive and a mentor to small businesses; he holds an MBA from Northwestern's Kellogg School and a doctorate in education.

His method pairs guided meditation with Hemi-Sync binaural-beat audio, using the accounts of thousands of near-death experiencers as a map so that listeners can explore states such as the light, the tunnel and meeting guides without coming close to death. He is the voice and author of the six Into the Light albums published by Hemi-Sync, created a five-and-a-half-day NDE Intensive, teaches on-demand courses in bi-location on The Shift Network, and gives talks on what these experiences suggest about consciousness. He runs the Expanded Awareness Institute from his home in Virginia's Blue Ridge Mountains.

courses.title: Into the Light: Near-Death Experience Meditations
courses.description: The first album in his series: four guided exercises with Hemi-Sync binaural audio and original music that walk the listener through the main stages people report in near-death experiences. A guidance manual comes with it.

courses.title: Into the Light: Meeting Your Guides
courses.description: A guided exercise that prepares body, mind and energy for inner exploration and introduces the guides near-death experiencers describe, followed by an open session to spend time with them. It also teaches his bi-location technique.

courses.title: Into the Light: Free Flow Meditations
courses.description: A companion album with less narration, leaving long stretches of quiet to explore the white light, the park and the other states introduced in the first album. It can also be used for open meditation.

courses.title: Into the Light: The Complete Series
courses.description: All six of his Into the Light albums together, from the first near-death meditations through the tunnel, guides, source and love themes. Sold as downloads with the guidance manuals.
